scope: Exploratory motion-only event prediction, development runs only. Not a final confirmation evaluation.
validation: Leave one full development run out. No random window splitting. No performance computed for proposed confirmation or B_5.
outcome: Any different nonzero annotated target within next 2 seconds
motion_route_definition: Infer movement heading from the latest 0.5s displacement. If speed <0.10m/s, heading is unknown. Without validated geometry it is not mapped to an exit label.

fixed_rule.logic: recent_speed < 0.25 OR (early/recent speed >= 0.10 AND absolute turn > 30 degrees)

fitting_weights: Equal total weight per training run, then per person-run within run, then per window within person-run
threshold_rationale: A fixed exploratory operating point; not optimized using validation outcomes and not a deployment recommendation.
rare_event_reporting: 30 positive windows correspond to 15 distinct transitions. Dependent windows are not independent events. No significance test or new-subject generalization claim.
no_map_boundary: No nearest-exit, inferred-exit-retention, line-of-sight, queue, neighbor or guidance-effect claims in this pilot.
